annotations.title: Cross-Asset Spot Exchange Rate & Satoshi Conversion Calculator

description: Calculates instantaneous spot exchange rates and equivalent USD, BTC, and satoshi values across BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, and USDC. Use when converting a token amount into USD or satoshis for invoice pricing or accounting; for quoting executable non-KYC cross-chain bridge routes with bridge fees and settlement times, use compare_crosschain_bridge_routes instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'currency' ('amount' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (100 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

amount.description: Quantity of the source asset to convert; defaults to 100 when omitted.

currency.description: Source asset ticker symbol to convert from.

name: calculate_spot_swap_rate

equivalent_sats.description: Equivalent value denominated in Bitcoin satoshis.

total_usd_value.description: Equivalent spot value in US Dollars (USD).

title: Cross-Asset Spot Exchange Rate & Satoshi Conversion Calculator
